title: Worse app update EVER. Used to a great up until changed without taking into account the end user.
body: It's look like some one was given the task of updating the old app with few days deadline and came up with this useless disorganised, confusing, complicated design, and non user friendly banking app. I have used other bank apps and this is the worse and give it 3 out of 10 rating. Even that the previous version was outdated but alot easier to use and more user friendly. This interface and design needs urgent review . Update: in December 2018 I sent an email feedback to ADCB and they acknowledged receiving my email but I guess no one at ADCB care about their loyal customers . It is the time to take action and leave this bank as so far I cant used this app because Iam confused and don't know how much money I have or how much I need to pay my credit card at the end of the month. What an horrible confusing mobile banking up and horrible customer service.
author: CazCazCaz Caz

So i left with an request form and downloaded the mobile app and still there is nooooooo where that I can see how to request a check book. On my online banking I still can’t seem to find the tab that requests the cheque book. This really frustrates me as I spent half of my off time to still have no cheque book requested. Shocking honestly as ENBD has that feature inside their app that I can order my chequebook.

body:
I am new to this apps and this bank, and yet problem is already there! 
My friend encourage me to open up an account to this bank bcoz they said no minimum balance required and no charge even u have zero balance.
But sending money is the problem to this account!
I try to send money outside uae, there no other option but only their own option which 2-5 working days, and has 105aed charge which is too much! 
And they didn’t mention on the apps that 2-5 working days the weekends are not included!
And after 5days my money just came back to my acct and it’s less than i send. 
I call their customer care but they say i need to wait again 3 working day for them to let me know why it didn’t when through and got back to my acct. like what the...! My family needs the money so im sending them and i use this bank and apps to less hussle! But it turns out too much hussle for me and now almost 7days included weekends and i need to wait more 3days to know the reason why?! 
And IT IS NOT EVEN SURE IF THEY WILL GONNA GIVE BACK MY MONEY! OMG! 
IM TOO MUCH DISAPPOINTED!

body:
Don’t sign up with ADCB if you want to experience bad customer service. I am getting no notification for point of sale transactions since MARCH and they said we stopped sending alert. They asked me to wait for 2-3 days until I can see them on my mobile app. I won’t receive SMS either for any of the transactions either. 

Who will remember transaction amount for 2-3 days and keep track of it if you were charged correctly or not? 

It’s completely useless and I plan to move to a different bank very soon. Disappointed.
